name: io.github.tessaryai/tessary
description: Read-only MCP tools for a self-hosted Tessary instance: cases, findings, traces, and spans.

environmentVariables.name: TESSARY_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.description: The origin of your self-hosted Tessary instance, e.g. https://tessary.example.com or http://localhost

environmentVariables.name: TESSARY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: An admin-scoped project API key (tsy_a_...), minted under Settings → MCP tokens in your instance

origin.description: Your Tessary instance's hostname, e.g. tessary.example.com
